image_description: A close-up photograph of two white daisy-like flowers with yellow centers against a blurred natural background. The primary flower is in sharp focus on the right, showing distinct white ray petals and a textured yellow disc. A second, slightly out-of-focus flower is visible at the bottom center. Green stems support both flowers, rising from a soft-focus background of green foliage and earth tones.

focus_areas: Edge integrity of white petals against dark/complex background
Texture consistency of the yellow disc florets
Naturalness of the bokeh/blur in the background
Structural connection of stems to flower heads
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the white petals and the background. AI generators often create 'halos' or smudge edges here. Also, verify if the yellow center texture looks procedurally generated (repeating patterns) or naturally random. Check if the second flower's blur level is consistent with its distance relative to the main flower.
